## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (a spec, a validator rule, or a render check)
- [ ] No network access, `shell=True`, `eval` or `innerHTML` was added (see SECURITY.md)
- [ ] README / SECURITY.md / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Demo media in `docs/media` regenerated if the visuals changed (large files: say so in the PR)
- [ ] I did not add secrets, personal data or voice models to the repository
